record.paper_title: Some New Results of Two Open Problems Related to Integral Inequalities
record.context_brief: Power refinement of an integral inequality
record.original_question: Let [a,b] be a real interval, let f be a nonnegative continuous real-valued function on [a,b], and let α>0 and β>0. Assume that for every x in [a,b], ∫_x^b f(t)^{min(1,β)} dt ≥ ∫_x^b (t-a)^{min(1,β)} dt. Determine conditions on α, β, and an exponent λ under which the strengthened integral inequality ∫_a^b f(x)^{α+β} dx ≥ (∫_a^b (x-a)^α f(x)^β dx)^λ holds.

evidence.quote: Abstract. In this paper, we have solved two open problems, and as consequence some interesting integral inequalities are obtained.
THEOREM 1.1. Let f(x) ≥ 0 be a continuous function on [a,b] satisfying ∫_x^b f^{min{1,β}}(t)dt ≥ ∫_x^b (t−a)^{min{1,β}}dt, ∀x∈[a,b].
Open Problem 1. Under what conditions does the inequality ∫_a^b f^{α+β}(x)dx ≥ (∫_a^b (x−a)^α f^β(x)dx)^λ hold for α,β and λ ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $[a,b] \subset \mathbb{R}$ with $a<b$, let $\alpha>0$ and $\beta>0$ be real parameters, and let $f:[a,b]\to[0,\infty)$ be a continuous function satisfying the assumption
$$\int_x^b f(t)^{\min\{1,\beta\}}\,dt \;\geq\; \int_x^b (t-a)^{\min\{1,\beta\}}\,dt \qquad \text{for every } x \in [a,b].$$
Determine all triples $(\alpha,\beta,\lambda)$ of real numbers (with $\alpha,\beta>0$) for which the inequality
$$\int_a^b f(x)^{\alpha+\beta}\,dx \;\geq\; \left(\int_a^b (x-a)^{\alpha}\,f(x)^{\beta}\,dx\right)^{\lambda}$$
holds for every such function $f$. In particular, give explicit admissible values of the exponent $\lambda$ in terms of $\alpha$, $\beta$, and the length $b-a$.
